read: 2026-10-08, by eye from the cached schematic image
comment: Vintage magazine schematic of a two-tube 50 Hz low-pass (crossover) filter, -3 dB at 5 Hz and 50 Hz, 12 dB/octave, with its own mains supply (6X4 rectifier, DC heater supply). No designators except tubes; resistors 1/2W 10% unless marked.
uncertain: 1 MEG at V2 grid: drawn as variable resistor, could be a front-panel control rather than a trimmer
rows: V1 and V2 (second section) grid return
two cathode resistors to ground (V1, V2 second section) and one series resistor after V1 cathode
marked *: may be changed to 3.3 MEG for 6 dB overall gain; unity gain with 1.5 MEG
V2 first section plate to supply B
input coupling and V2 interstage coupling
no part number given; 500 mA 50 PIV, heater supply rectifiers
rectifier tube in the mains power supply
input level pot; no taper given
variable resistor from V2 grid to ground (wiper tied to ground end), filter adjustment
